newsitem.title: ITALY: Fiat plans to cut Nov output by 26,500 cars.
newsitem.headline: Fiat plans to cut Nov output by 26,500 cars.

text.p: Italian carmaker Fiat SpA has informed its unions about temporary layoffs for November which forecast a production cut of 26,500 vehicles.
In the period November 4-10 some 28,000 workers will be temporarily laid off, some 15,000 during November 11-17, 13,500 in November 18-24 and 17,000 between November 25 and December 1.

The layoffs will affect Fiat's northern Italian car plants of Rivalta, Mirafiori and Arese, Cassino in the south and Termini Imerese in Sicily. The move will affect production of Lancia K, Delta, Dedra, Alfa Romeo 145, 146, 155, GTV and Spider, and also the Fiat Punto and Bravo/Brava models.

Fiat also announced for October the closure of a shift for the Alfa GTV and Spider line at Arese in the last two weeks of the month and the suspension of production at Rivalta from October 28 to November 3 involving production of Lancia K, Delta and Dedra, and the Fiat Bravo.
